items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps oily skin feeling fresh without stripping it.
Ceramides help support a comfortable moisture barrier, which suits the lower moisture score without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection, and pregnancy can make skin tone changes more noticeable.

response.routine_note: We've left the adapalene gel out of this routine because it is a retinoid, so please check with your doctor or midwife about acne products that suit your skin during pregnancy. Meanwhile, cleanse gently morning and night, moisturize, and apply the mineral SPF every morning.
